fields.description: Issue dated October 6, 1928, edited by Wen R. Phillips. Includes commentary on the return of the tourist season; a feature on how many hurricanes have struck Miami with recollections from early residents; satirical coverage of Florida Governor John M. Martin and the aftermath of the 1928 storm; local political and civic notes (League of Women Voters, voter registration questions, Miami city commission actions); discussion of Coral Gables police department changes and Hialeah municipal finance controversy; a letter from Assistant State Game Commissioner Newton Lewis regarding arrests for killing alligators and shooting from the Tamiami Trail; and assorted local entertainment, sports, and advertising content.
